title: Why Is Everyone Talking About Meta Stock?
creator: Parkevtate Vosianc CFA
summary: Parkevtate Vosianc explains why so many investors are talking about Meta: the Muse personal agent. It has grown to over 10 million users in roughly its first month and a half, and management told his members-only earnings live session that it could prove even more lucrative per user than a typical social-media user, where Zuckerberg already cites average revenue per American user in the several hundreds of dollars a year. Average transaction value through the agent is already around $200. Monetisation is still being built: commerce tools that pay Meta a fee on each transaction the agent facilitates, and subscriptions for the most advanced models or extra tokens. The agent is expensive to run, but Meta is building capacity to serve more than a billion people over the next few years and expects compute cost efficiency to improve tenfold within a year — roughly a 90% cost reduction — which he finds plausible given distribution across Facebook, Instagram and the other apps with several billion daily users. His back-of-the-envelope maths: 200 million US and Canada users at about $200 of average revenue each would be $40 billion a year before any global rollout. As a shareholder he is optimistic, but he states no valuation, fair value or buy, sell or hold ranking in this video. The call is META — UNCERTAIN, commentary only; his earlier BUY stands.
